adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog`, the `Dialog` uses `onOpenChange={setIsOpenDialog}`, so closing via ESC/backdrop will only flip `isOpenDialog` without resetting local state. `multiEmailValue` and `isInvalidEmail` are only reset in the Cancel button handler, and on success only `multiEmailValue` is reset (`setMultiEmailValue([""])`) while `isInvalidEmail` is not cleared. This can leave a stale error banner (and potentially stale entered emails if closed without Cancel) when reopening the dialog.
